status: non-authoritative historical requirements mapping; not an implementation, acceptance, browser, asset, truth, or review result

evidence_boundary.statement: The catalog identity is frozen baseline identity, while all mapped scene, logic, route, API, and test behavior is historical.
No current route, implementation, runnable behavior, or global absence conclusion is made by this blueprint.
Browser observations, compact/wide outcomes, live asset use, asset suitability, licensing, API success, persistence, and authorization remain outside this mapping.

identity.historical_requirement: Preserve the catalog identity id, title, realm/twin-soul description, cover reference, and playable catalog status only as baseline catalog data.

scenes.name: start
scenes.historical_requirement: Provide the historical title, Gargoyle Defense framing, defense/rescue/matching instructions, auto-fire control text, and Begin Defense action.

scenes.name: playing
scenes.historical_requirement: Represent a playing phase backed by player, enemies, bullets, target index, score, wave, elapsed time, answer counters, and victory/defeat state.

scenes.name: ended
scenes.historical_requirement: Branch historical result copy between successful defense and realm overrun, with restart and exit actions.

transitions.historical_requirement: Starting creates historical game state and changes the phase to playing.
A historical animation-frame loop ticks with delta capped at 50ms.
Historical victory or defeat changes the phase to ended and invokes completion once with calculated XP and accuracy.
Restart returns to start and exit assigns the student-games path.

initialization.historical_requirement: Initialize a four-by-six enemy formation with two first-row bosses and playing state.

movement.historical_requirement: Move and horizontally clamp the player from horizontal input.
Move non-diving enemies horizontally and reverse them at bounds.
Use the historical configuration for game dimensions, player HP, auto-fire cadence, movement values, enemy formation, enemy speed/points, and colors; no current tuning is inferred.

waves.historical_requirement: When no enemies remain during play, increment wave, target index, correct answers, and total attempts.
Set victory at the vocabulary-length target boundary; otherwise create a fresh formation.

target_capture_rescue_twin_shot.historical_requirement: On a qualifying capture condition, mark the player captured, mark the captor, restore its position, assign it the indexed vocabulary word, and assign sampled non-target words to other enemies.

On a qualifying player-bullet hit, remove the enemy and bullet, add enemy points, and rescue a captured player by setting twin-soul state and clearing captured state when the hit enemy holds the player.
The mapping does not infer a user-selected target mechanic, deterministic sampled labels, or observed live presentation.

projectiles.historical_requirement: Auto-fire player bullets after the configured interval, move player bullets upward and enemy bullets downward, and remove bullets outside extended vertical bounds.

collision_and_health.historical_requirement: Apply the historical proximity rule for player-bullet enemy hits and rescue behavior.
Enemy bullets and qualifying diving-enemy proximity decrement HP and may set defeat at zero-or-less HP.

terminal_and_xp.historical_requirement: Treat victory and defeat as historical terminal guards rather than observed reachable outcomes.
Calculate zero XP with no attempts; otherwise combine correct-word base XP with conditional perfect-accuracy, at-least-half-health, and under-30-second bonuses capped at ten.

active_surface.historical_requirement: Render a scaled Konva stage with target translation, bullets, enemy labels and capture indicators, player/twin-soul marker, wave/score/HP HUD, and VirtualDPad dx-to-velocity wiring.

composition.historical_requirement: Use container dimensions and the smaller width-to-game-width or height-to-game-height scale, with historical h-[75vh], md:aspect-video, and md:h-auto container composition.

unknown_boundary.historical_requirement: Do not claim compact or wide browser behavior from the historical composition source.

route.historical_requirement: Dynamically import the game without SSR after a session user exists, fetch vocabulary, render loading/error/page-chrome branches, and post XP and accuracy from completion.

apis.historical_requirement: Expose GET through createVocabularyRoute(SAMPLE_VOCABULARY) with force-static.
Expose POST through createCompleteRoute with force-static.

tests.historical_requirement: The logic-test scope covers initialization, movement bounds, controlled auto-fire, projectile movement/removal, enemy hit/score, diving damage, capture/rescue/vocabulary assignment, wave advance, and XP branches.
The component-test scope uses mocks and covers initial title/button rendering, click transition to mocked stage, and a post-start rect count; it is not browser evidence.

asset_inventory.historical_requirement: Treat the named catalog cover PNG as baseline binary identity only.
Treat the named vocabulary cover PNG as baseline binary identity only.

unknowns.statement: Current implementation and route runnability are not mapped.
Real browser input, compact/wide rendering, console/network behavior, and terminal reachability are not mapped.
Asset visual content, use, suitability, license, and live surface correlation are not mapped.
API authentication, response, persistence, authorization, and completion success are not mapped.

developer_effort_decomposition.scope: State initialization, movement, projectile lifecycle, collision, capture/rescue, health, waves, terminal guards, and XP calculation.
Start, playing, and ended branches; Konva surface; HUD; target/capture indicators; and VirtualDPad wiring.
Container measurement and scale composition, with browser outcome validation explicitly deferred.
Locale page loading/error flow, vocabulary fetch, completion post, and API-route wiring.
Logic and mocked component test scopes; real browser validation is a separate role.
Current runtime, browser behavior, asset use/suitability, and API outcomes require their assigned evidence roles before any implementation conclusion.

non_mapping_evidence.reason: Negative fixtures are explicit rejection targets and are not factual claim coverage.
